root_causes.detail: Frame-level vision evidence contained central-subject/template/text checks, but the router aggregate omitted them. The DB validator correctly rejected PROOF_VERIFIED writeback.

Supabase powerhouse-instagram-media-verifier runtime lagged GitHub main and did not return the newer strict visual fields, causing aggregate proof to evaluate mira_central_subject=false despite otherwise successful frame checks.
The orchestrator select-pending client path using limit(1).maybeSingle() failed while equivalent SQL returned one row. Pending selection is hardened to limit(1) plus first-row extraction.

prevention: Aggregate Reel proof must preserve mira_central_subject, text_dominant and brand_template_dominant from every verified frame.
Production Edge Function runtime identity must be compared against canonical GitHub main before terminal publication claims.
A successful proof write must be followed by media-job and obligation readback; partial evidence is not terminal delivery.
Pending queue selectors must tolerate one-row arrays and must not rely on maybeSingle when the runtime path has shown instability.
